findings.applicability: Released aggregate evidence may motivate a subset test but never measures it.
findings.explanation: support[0] states that the 2020 released validation 'for the same diagnostic' passed predictive validation. The released evaluation measured the [8,12,16] rule; the proposed 12 UTC subset was never measured. This attributes an aggregate result to a subset.

findings.applicability: Predictive falsification must stay separate from admission or administrative outcomes.
findings.explanation: The falsifier joins a predictive condition (no positive candidate-versus-baseline gap) with an administrative one (admissibility requiring conversion of the deferred cost item). An administrative rejection cannot falsify predictive value.

findings.applicability: Linking a repeated market idea to its earlier attempt.
findings.explanation: The draft re-proposed the recorded 12 UTC diagnostic as a retained draft with corrected cost scope. The v2 contract offered no linked-revision route, so the correct lineage could not be expressed and the service rejected it as DUPLICATE under the then-policy. The SAME_IDEA_REVISION_CANDIDATE annotation records this as a service limitation; no confirmed agent lineage error follows.

findings.applicability: Scope declaration of deferred cost prerequisites.
findings.explanation: broker_costs is scoped future_economic with a reason and reactivation condition consistent with the price-only catalog.

limitations: Human finding decisions supplied via the project conversation and transcribed by Codex. The reviewer and transcribing assessor are outcome-exposed; REVIEWED does not imply an outcome-blind assessment.
The assessor had read later development results, corrections and the 2.12/2.13 audit before assessing; this is not an ex-ante assessment.
The duplicate rejection reflects the v2 policy; the v3 contract later added the revision route.
reason: Explicit human review supplied in the project conversation on 10 October 2026; Codex transcribed the finding decisions and limitations. Original assessment retained by supersession; no new agent inference or market evaluation. Mini v2 draft: correct cost scope, but aggregate-to-subset attribution and a mixed falsifier; lineage route did not exist.
